# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly woman, living at Green Gables for sixty years  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v2 c18 P9](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Mistress of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla Cuthbert is a tall, gaunt woman with graying hair, possessing a stern expression and a practical, grim posture. She is known to wear plain attire and carries herself with quiet authority.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015)_

## Personality

Marilla is practical, strict, and firmly grounded in common sense and traditional decorum. She is opposed to foolish daydreams or imagining things to be different than they are. Despite her grim exterior and strict discipline, she possesses a dry sense of humor and deep-seated warmth and compassion, softening over time through her relationship with Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)_

## Goals

- To bring up Anne Shirley properly and teach her obedience and practical duties  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c19 P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert arranged with her brother Matthew to adopt an orphan boy to help on their farm at Green Gables. Due to a misunderstanding, Mrs. Spencer brought eleven-year-old Anne Shirley instead. Although initially inclined to return Anne and avoid taking on an unexpected girl, Marilla sympathized with Anne's miserable situation after visiting Mrs. Blewett. She agreed to keep Anne on trial, instructing her in domestic tasks, religious lessons, and decorum. When Mrs. Rachel Lynde criticized Anne's physical appearance and provoked a passionate outburst from the girl, Marilla defended Anne while still requiring her to apologize. Over time, Marilla formed a firm bond with Anne, raising her into a young woman and later taking in the orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P18](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0018), [v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c18 P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)_

> I think you’d better learn to control that imagination of yours, Anne, if you can’t distinguish between what is real and what isn’t.  <sub>[v1 c6 P24](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0024)</sub>
